headline: Review of Geothermal & Explosive Engineering Feasibility documents for Seaside Legal Solutions, 123 Main Street, to satisfy condition 19.
summary: The subcommittee will discuss a memo to the Conservation Commission on an NOI, review feasibility documents for Seaside Legal Solutions at 123 Main Street, and go over a Condition Status document for board briefing.
